verdict.rationale: Transaction-monitoring rule and list management is a fair question for an AML/fraud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows APIs for customers, screening, cases, monitoring configuration, exports and transaction processing, plus vendor-run AI agents that escalate alerts to humans. It does not document any programmatic way to create or propose velocity rules, edit blocklists or watchlists, or put approval gates on rule changes. The configurable risk-score equation and case-review APIs are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
